posts.trend: Why rising maternity costs make family health insurance coverage more important
posts.context: Older relatives pressure young couples to have children while remaining oblivious to the modern economic realities of childcare.
posts.angle: Relatives want the social milestone of grandchildren but none of the actual line-item costs.
slides: "Pichle saal toh bola tha thoda wait karenge."

"Ab toh do saal ho gaye shaadi ko."
"Humare zamaane mein toh insurance nahi tha."
"Paisa toh aata jaata rehta hai."
"Ek pyara sa baby ghar aa jaye bas."

They want a grandchild.

But they are not on the co-pay sheet.
posts.caption: Whose mother-in-law thinks hospital bills can be paid in family blessings? 👶
posts.rank_verdict: An exceptionally sharp contrast between warm family expectations and cold financial reality.
